definition: Cooperative training is a learning approach in which an animal is taught, using positive reinforcement, to voluntarily take part in handling or examination procedures. In the source context, it means training the animal to cooperate with positioning and contact so procedures can be completed while the animal is awake and without restraint or anesthesia.
